covariant_operator_basis.H1: H1_mn = R R_mn - 1/4 g_mn R^2 + g_mn Box R - nabla_m nabla_n R
covariant_operator_basis.H2: H2_mn = 2 R_manb R^ab - 1/2 g_mn R_ab R^ab + Box R_mn + 1/2 g_mn Box R - nabla_m nabla_n R
covariant_operator_basis.bulk_action: Gamma_4D = integral sqrt(-g) [M2/2 R - Lambda + alpha R^2 + beta R_mn R^mn] + Gamma_nonlocal + S_matter
covariant_operator_basis.cap_projection_definition: H_L[I_i] = normalized second variation of integral sqrt(g) I_i on the compact-cap coexact L channel
covariant_operator_basis.field_equation: M2 G_mn + 2 alpha H1_mn + beta H2_mn + Hnonlocal_mn = T_mn
covariant_operator_basis.gauss_bonnet_note: In four dimensions Riemann^2 may be exchanged for R^2 and Ricci^2 plus the Euler density and a boundary transgression.

external_matching_stage: marginalize over an explicit equation-of-state family
infer an allowed coefficient region rather than select by eye
freeze the matched coefficients and renormalization scale
forbidden: using neutron-star data inside the cap-regularity theorem
retuning coefficients separately for each star or equation of state
identifying cap coefficients with 4D curvature coefficients before projection
claiming microscopic derivation from empirical matching
held_out_stage: predict stars or observables excluded from calibration
reject the bridge if held-out mass-radius, tidal, or stability tests fail
internal_stage: compute the cap projection of each covariant local operator
test a genuinely dynamical Berger modulus and its Hessian
compute the nonlocal fermion polarization with one declared regulator

background_equations: E^theta_theta = p as consistency / additional higher-derivative equation
observables: moment of inertia when rotation is added
stellar_structure.radial_stability: delta E=0 with Lagrangian displacement xi and auxiliary curvature perturbations; solve L_rad Y = omega^2 W_rad Y, require omega_0^2>0
surface_and_exterior: metric and required higher-derivative data matched to the vacuum exterior
asymptotic or parent-relative boundary conditions declared
stellar_structure.tidal_problem: solve static even-parity ell=2 linearized equations through the surface and extract the response/source ratio defining the Love number
